evals.name: landing-minimal-dark-developers
evals.prompt:
/product-design landing minimal dark
Pipewise — a data pipeline tool. Visitors are developers who already know the category and just want to try it. Goal: start a free trial. We have no customer quotes, logos, or usage numbers yet.
evals.expected_output: A short developer-focused landing page in Minimal dark: hero with a product visual, features, a direct trial CTA. No testimonials, customer logos, or stats.
expectations: The page is short: hero, features, and a call to action, with nothing that slows a developer down
The CTA asks for a free trial
There are no testimonials, customer logos, or usage numbers
Visuals follow Minimal dark: achromatic, zero shadow, sharp 2px buttons

evals.name: landing-minimal-light-it-directors
evals.prompt:
/product-design landing minimal
Pipewise — a data pipeline tool. Visitors are IT directors who have never heard of this category and worry about security. Goal: book a demo. We have no customer testimonials yet.
evals.expected_output: Same product as case 1, different visitors: the page explains the problem, shows how it works, addresses security, answers questions, and asks for a demo. No testimonials.
expectations: The page explains the problem before listing features
There is a how-it-works section and a section that addresses security
The CTA asks for a demo, not a self-serve trial
There are no testimonials or customer logos
The structure is clearly different from case 1

evals.name: pricing-business-dark-agency
evals.prompt:
/product-design pricing business dark
It's for Ledgerline, invoice automation for small creative agencies. Audience: agency owners, not finance people. Main barrier: they worry it'll be complicated to switch from spreadsheets. We have no customer testimonials yet. Plans: Starter $19/mo, Studio $49/mo, Agency $129/mo.
evals.expected_output: A Business-style dark pricing page with three tiers at the given prices, something that answers the switching worry, and no invented proof, annual discounts, or 'Most Popular' claims.
expectations: Three tiers show exactly $19, $49 and $129 per month
The page addresses the worry about switching from spreadsheets
There is no billing toggle or annual discount, because no annual prices were given
No tier is labeled 'Most Popular'
Visuals follow Business dark: Plus Jakarta Sans, 8px buttons, inset-ring cards

evals.name: blog-editorial-dark-expert
evals.prompt:
/product-design blog editorial dark
Blog index for Fieldnotes, the research publication of a small applied-AI lab. Use archetype B (Editorial). No newsletter section. Six articles: "Why retrieval beats fine-tuning for most teams" (Research), "Evaluating agents without a leaderboard" (Research), "What we got wrong about context windows" (Essays), "A field guide to prompt caching" (Engineering), "Notes from shipping a voice agent" (Engineering), "The case for boring infrastructure" (Essays). Featured: the retrieval article.
evals.expected_output: An Editorial dark blog index in archetype B: the retrieval article featured, the other five in a mixed grid, category filters, no newsletter, no pagination for six articles.
expectations: Archetype B is used, as requested
The retrieval article is featured; all six titles appear
There is no newsletter section and no pagination
Clicking a category filter does not make the page jump
Headlines use the Editorial serif; the accent is teal

text_required: Why retrieval beats fine-tuning for most teams

evals.name: landing-colorful-dark-oneliner
evals.prompt:
/product-design landing colorful dark
Patchwork — a shared moodboard app for small design studios.
evals.expected_output: A Colorful dark landing page built from one sentence: no questions asked, a creative-tool layout, copy inferred from the sentence, missing proof filled with tagged sample content, nothing presented as a real fact.
expectations: No questions were asked before the page was generated
The layout suits a creative tool
The page is complete: evidence sections are present, filled with sample content marked data-sample
Every sample item is listed in the QA report
The delivery note offers the next level of detail

evals.name: about-editorial-light-bare
evals.expected_output: An Editorial About page generated with no information at all: default archetype, missing material filled with finished-looking sample content tagged data-sample and listed in the QA report.
expectations: A complete page was generated without asking for the company name
Missing material (team, story, values) is filled with finished-looking sample content, marked data-sample and listed in the QA report
No sample content is presented as a real fact without data-sample
The page looks complete and polished, not empty

evals.name: hero-business-section

/product-design hero business
For Relay, a shared inbox for customer-support teams of 5–50 people.
evals.expected_output: Just a hero section in Business style, standalone: no nav or footer, a product visual of a shared inbox, no customer logos.
expectations: Only the hero is produced — no nav, no footer
The product visual looks like a shared inbox
Buttons use Business values (16px, 12px 24px padding, 8px radius)
There are no customer logos or metrics

evals.name: contact-business-light-sales
evals.prompt:
/product-design contact business
Northwind CRM. Most people who contact us want a sales demo; support questions go to our help center. Sales email: sales@northwind.example
evals.expected_output: A Business contact page leaning toward sales: a demo-request form, the sales email, a route to the help center for support, no invented office addresses or phone numbers.

Support visitors are pointed to the help center

evals.name: product-colorful-light-integrations
evals.prompt:
/product-design product colorful
Loomcast — async video messages for remote teams. Capabilities: screen and camera recording, automatic transcripts, threaded replies, viewer analytics. Integrates with Slack, Notion, Linear, and Google Drive. Audience: team leads evaluating tools for a 20–200 person company. No customer logos or quotes we can use yet.

evals.name: 404-minimal-dark-bare

expectations: The site nav is kept as an escape route
